verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party features page says users can track progress "using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars", which names all four views in the story. The evidence is a single marketing line with no depth. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of switching between views of the same work items, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the views stay in sync.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
